capabilities: Metadata, data quality, lineage, ownership and contracts
limitation: Avoid operating a duplicate enterprise catalog
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Technical/business metadata, quality, ownership and lineage with stable asset identifiers.
scientific_qualification.output: A unified metadata graph and schema-based context.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Catalog declarations may be incomplete or stale; technical lineage and business associations do not establish causal direction.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Integrate the bank's chosen catalog instead of requiring a second one. Qualify selected OSS connectors/API behavior before implementation; broad README capability lists are not an end-to-end test.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Reconcile a schema/ownership change and trace affected analysis inputs; retain unresolved definitions and verify no inferred adjustment set follows solely from catalog links.
